### Caesars Palace Brings Barcelona’s SIPS Drinkery House to Las Vegas Starting Oct. 31


10/28/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/Caesars-Palace-Brings-Barcelonas-SIPS-Drinkery-House-to-Las-Vegas-Starting-Oct--31-2026-QvggMn4AwE-2026.pdf)


**Caesars Palace Brings Barcelona’s SIPS Drinkery House** **to Las Vegas Starting Oct. 31**


**


*The World's Best Bar in 2023 pours its signature cocktails* *at VISTA Cocktail Lounge in a two-month pop-up through Dec. 31*


**


****For high-res images, click***[here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1kCxieA52RM2_EKKOsOi4RRkeHuO8owb5?usp=sharing) *******


******


**Key Facts:**


- Barcelona’s SIPS Drinkery House, named The World’s Best Bar in 2023, arrives at VISTA Cocktail Lounge inside Caesars Palace.
- The limited-time pop-up runs Saturday, Oct. 31, through Thursday, Dec. 31.
- The 16-cocktail menu pairs SIPS signatures with drinks created especially for Caesars Palace.


**LAS VEGAS (Oct. 28, 2026) –** SIPS Drinkery House will launch its limited-time Las Vegas pop-up at VISTA Cocktail Lounge inside Caesars Palace on Saturday, Oct. 31. Available through Thursday, Dec. 31, the experience showcases the acclaimed Barcelona bar’s flavor-first approach and clever presentation as Caesars Palace celebrates its 60th anniversary.


Named The World's Best Bar by The World’s 50 Best Bars 2023, SIPS has remained among the industry's elite, ranking No. 3 globally in both 2024 and 2025 while earning recognition as The Best Bar in Europe. Founded in 2021 by bartenders Simone Caporale and Marc Álvarez, the bar is known for blending innovative technique and familiar flavors with presentation designed to elevate, rather than distract from, each drink.


The pop-up menu features 16 cocktails, including SIPS favorites and several drinks created especially for Caesars Palace. Highlights include **Purple Rain** , a modern whiskey sour with bourbon, wild sour honey and beetroot; **Mosaic** , featuring pisco brandy and aromatic Amazon rainforest woods, served in a painted glass inspired by Barcelona’s modernist art movement; and **Krypta** , a multisensory cocktail combining Glenfiddich scotch, London dry gin and clarified apple. Served in a striking, egg-shaped glass with fresh herbs suspended inside, Krypta offers an aromatic element with every sip.


VISTA Cocktail Lounge will feature Barcelona skyline imagery and SIPS Drinkery House videos across its digital screens, along with branded decorative pillows and coasters. Select cocktails will be served in the same glassware used at SIPS in Barcelona.


VISTA Cocktail Lounge is near Amalfi by Bobby Flay and Dominique Ansel Las Vegas inside Caesars Palace. VISTA is open Monday through Thursday from 2 p.m. to 2 a.m., and Friday through Sunday from 10 a.m. to 2 a.m. For more information or to make a reservation, guests can visit[caesars.com/caesars-palace/things-to-do/nightlife/vista-cocktail-lounge](https://www.caesars.com/caesars-palace/things-to-do/nightlife/vista-cocktail-lounge) .


**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQs)**


****


**When is the SIPS pop-up at VISTA Cocktail Lounge available?**


Guests can experience the SIPS pop-up at VISTA Cocktail Lounge from Saturday, Oct. 31, through Thursday, Dec. 31, during operating hours.


**Where is VISTA Cocktail Lounge located at Caesars Palace?**


VISTA Cocktail Lounge is near Amalfi by Bobby Flay and Dominique Ansel Las Vegas inside Caesars Palace.


**What are the hours of operation for VISTA Cocktail Lounge?**


VISTA Cocktail Lounge is open Monday through Thursday from 2 p.m. to 2 a.m., and Friday through Sunday from 10 a.m. to 2 a.m.


**Is a reservation required for VISTA Cocktail Lounge? Where can guests make a reservation?**


Reservations are not required for VISTA Cocktail Lounge, but guests can reserve a table at[caesars.com/caesars-palace/things-to-do/nightlife/vista-cocktail-lounge](https://www.caesars.com/caesars-palace/things-to-do/nightlife/vista-cocktail-lounge) .


**What cocktails will be available during the SIPS pop-up?**


The menu will feature 16 cocktails, including SIPS favorites and several drinks created especially for Caesars Palace. Among the highlights are Purple Rain, Mosaic and Krypta. For more information, guests can visit[caesars.com/caesars-palace/things-to-do/nightlife/vista-cocktail-lounge](https://www.caesars.com/caesars-palace/things-to-do/nightlife/vista-cocktail-lounge) .


**How will VISTA Cocktail Lounge be transformed for the pop-up?**


During the pop-up, the lounge’s digital screens will showcase the Barcelona skyline and footage of SIPS Drinkery House, while branded pillows and coasters will be featured throughout the space. Select cocktails will be served in the same glassware used at SIPS in Barcelona.


**About SIPS Drinkery House**


SIPS Drinkery House is an award-winning cocktail destination in Barcelona, founded by renowned bartenders Simone Caporale and Marc Álvarez. Redefining the traditional cocktail bar experience, SIPS combines cutting-edge mixology, innovative presentation, and exceptional hospitality within an open environment designed to bring guests and bartenders closer together. The venue is built around the philosophy of elevating the drinking experience through creativity, flavour, and craftsmanship. Located in Barcelona's Eixample district, SIPS has earned international recognition as one of the world's leading bars, celebrated for its pioneering approach to cocktail culture and guest experience.


**About Caesars Palace**


Caesars Palace, the iconic Las Vegas Strip resort where every guest is treated like a Caesar, features 3,980 hotel guest rooms and[suites](https://www.caesars.com/las-vegas/suites) , including the redesigned 182-room[Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace](https://www.caesars.com/nobu-caesars-palace) , the renovated Colosseum Tower and[THE VILLAS Caesars Palace](https://www.caesars.com/suites/las-vegas/villas) , which has earned the prestigious AAA Five Diamond rating. Both Caesars Palace and Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace have also received AAA Four Diamond designations. The 85-acre resort offers diverse dining options from the award-winning Bacchanal Buffet to celebrity chef-branded restaurants, including Gordon Ramsay HELL’S KITCHEN, Pronto by Giada, Amalfi by Bobby Flay, Vanderpump Cocktail Garden by restaurateur and television star Lisa Vanderpump, one of Nobu Matsuhisa’s largest Nobu restaurants, MICHELIN-starred Restaurant Guy Savoy, award-winning pastry chef Dominique Ansel’s first Las Vegas bakery, Stanton Social Italian – a dining concept in partnership with Tao Group Hospitality, legendary New York Steak House Peter Luger and Brasserie B Parisian Steakhouse by Bobby Flay. The Celebrity Food Hall features Guy Fieri’s Chicken Guy!, Bobby’s Burgers by Bobby Flay, Tortazo by Rick Bayless, Buddy V’s Pizzeria and Mokbar by Esther Choi. For the best in cocktails, destination lounges include Montecristo Cigar Bar, VISTA Cocktail Lounge, Stadia Bar and Caspian’s – a cocktail and caviar bar with Clique Hospitality. The resort also features nearly 130,000 square feet of casino space, the Caesars Race & Sportsbook at Caesars Palace with a 143-foot HD LED screen and state-of-the-art sound, a five-acre Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis, the luxurious Qua Baths & Spa, Hairdreams by Michael Boychuck, five wedding chapels and gardens, the 75,000-square-foot OMNIA Nightclub and OMNIA Dayclub & Skybar on Las Vegas Boulevard. The 4,300-seat Colosseum is the most celebrated venue in Las Vegas with an impressive legacy of superstar talent featured in an intimate, once-in-a-lifetime setting. The Colosseum currently spotlights world-class entertainers, including LISA, Cyndi Lauper, Mötley Crüe, Sting, Tim McGraw and Rod Stewart. Also, the Green Fairy Garden in front of Caesars Palace hosts ABSINTHE by Spiegelworld, an adults-only circus variety show featuring a cocktail of wild and outlandish acts. The Forum Shops at Caesars Palace showcases more than 160 boutiques and restaurants. Caesars Palace is operated by a subsidiary of Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR).
